_comment: Order is the explicit task sequence. Use --start-at 3D to replace stale saved progress. Invalid task codes stop before starting any commands.
prompt_context: A useful task states what observable behavior should change and why, which decisions and interfaces are settled, what existing code and prerequisite work matter, and what would demonstrate success. Give the worker discretion over implementation details; do not use file allowlists. Follow docs/implementation-contracts.md: keep task prose separate from project-wide verification commands, and reconcile outdated mechanisms with the current workflow. Show progress toward requested behaviors, not just completed tasks. During the existing planning pass, map each requested behavior to its implementing task and expected evidence.
